newsitem.title: USA: ARCO to buy stake in Chinese refinery.
newsitem.headline: ARCO to buy stake in Chinese refinery.

text.p: Atlantic Richfield Co said it expects to buy a substantial portion of the convertible bonds to be issued in a recently announced public offering by China's Zhenhai Refining and Chemical Co.
Conversion of the bonds into Hong Kong-traded "H" shares, would result in ARCO owning about 20 percent stake in ZRCC, one of China's largest oil refiners.
The proposed issue of the convertible bonds is subject to shareholder and regulatory approval among other conditions.
ARCO already owns 237.6 million "H" shares, or 9.9% of ZRCC's issued capital.
These shares were bought for $70 million by ARCO's wholly-owned unit, ARCO Asia Pacific Investments Ltd, in a 1994 public offering.
ZRCC owns and operates a refinery complex in East China about 100 miles south of Shanghai.
